change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases c14, c15, n04, n09, n13 and n16 (two referenced, four native; none has run). The bank holds only two referenced cases that have not run: before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after 2026-11-13; for each one, add a `c` case and its reference row and shot, and run it in place of a native case, so the cycle has up to four referenced cases. With fewer than four, the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 3 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-3.md § Pin; its builder prompt is the model). Cycle 3 ran the six builders in parallel: the lead pre-registered the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owned one directory, and each builder built into its own dist directory and shot its own route; keep that, and tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus a keyboard frame per case (focus the first tabbable data element in <main>, press ArrowRight twice, wait 500 ms, shoot; log the announcement before and after the keys), plus a pointer sweep across the gap between two adjacent marks if v3-expr-3-rubric landed. (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md, the keyboard log, and for a c case the reference shot. Tell it to open every shot, and that a one-tab-stop host keeps DOM focus while the announcement names the item the keys reached. (4) Repair: hand the builder its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `note` to that row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts, or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. v3-freeze-g4 closed (issue 1227) before cycle 3 filed: say in the cycle file which gate a `primitive` or `doctrine` P1 should hold instead, and raise it with the owner rather than editing another row. Add two new cases to the bank from sources not used yet. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 3: (a) the playground's index.css lists its Tailwind sources by hand and misses src/charts, so every ChartCard box collapses in loading, empty and error; v3-expr-3-kit-fixes (7) adds the line with the outline fixes it exposes. Check before round 0 that it landed and that every package folder a scenario reaches is in the list; if not, the lead adds it on the trial branch for the shots and takes it out before merge, as cycle 3 did; (b) builders opened a subset of their own shots and none opened a keyboard frame; v3-expr-3-skill names the frames, so check its text is what the builders read; (c) run `make check-fast` before scoring round 0, and stop it before builders start round 1 if it is still queued for a slot, since round 1 edits the tree; (d) the public `VX` object referenced 50 `--vx-*` names v3 never emits (issue 1539), which the cycle-3 builds used and which paint black once the 2.x shim left; before round 0, check that every `VX` member a builder can reach resolves on a playground page, and say in the cycle file if 1539 is still open; (e) report every score on all items and, for the trend against cycles 1 and 2, on the F and K items alone; cycle 3's trend rows carry both.
